# Tokenectomy Razor

> The autonomous M2M sub-cortex and log surgery engine for AI coding agents.

Tokenectomy Razor is a zero-allocation, machine-to-machine (M2M) Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in safe Rust. It sits between terminal execution and LLM context windows, excising 95%+ internal framework noise, redacting credentials with O(N) ReDoS-immune DFA regexes, and streaming sanitized context in sub-milliseconds with zero dirty git diff.

## Core Documentation

- [Quick Start & Overview](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/): Architecture, core capabilities, and verified benchmarks.
- [Installation Guide](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/installation/): Cargo (`cargo install tokenectomy`), npm (`npx tokenectomy-razor`), Homebrew, Docker, and standalone binary downloads.
- [MCP Server Setup](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/mcp-integration/): JSON configuration for Cursor Composer, Claude Desktop, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, and Antigravity.
- [AI Gateway Proxy](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/proxy/): Local streaming proxy (`127.0.0.1:8080`) that sanitizes prompts and stack traces before forwarding to upstream LLMs.
- [CLI Reference](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/cli/): Full flag reference including `--scrub`, `--mcp`, `--proxy`, `--port`, and `--verify-patch`.
- [Security Model & Telemetry](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/security/): ReDoS immunity proof, zero-knowledge local architecture, and secret redaction rules.
- [Verified Benchmarks](https://tokenectomy-labs.github.io/Tokenectomy/#verifiable-benchmarks): Sub-millisecond latency measurements, memory footprint (<77MB VmRSS), and Gitleaks head-to-head comparison.

## MCP Tools Exposed

1. `get_error_context`: Prunes framework stack traces from Python, Node/TS, Go, Rust, Java, C++, Ruby, PHP, and C#; auto-redacts credentials.
2. `analyze_code`: Performs static AST code analysis to detect resource leaks, unclosed handles, and security vulnerabilities with LSP coordinates.
3. `apply_code_patch`: AST-validated dry-run patching with automatic rollback on syntax error.
4. `search_stack_overflow`: Sanitized web search extracting targeted programming error solutions.
5. `audit_context_health`: Proactively audits error logs, prompt payloads, or code snippets for token bloat, framework noise, and credential leaks.
